item.title: ‘The Invite’ is the cathartic result of actor-director Olivia Wilde’s taste for storytelling
item.description: While "The Invite" is simply a snapshot of one evening in these four people’s lives, much like a play, the story covers a wealth of themes from love to sex to unhappiness. What ends up on the screen, actor-director Olivia Wilde said, is ultimately a very specific blend of the four actors and the script. item.title: A remote mountain story finds a global stage with ‘To Hold a Mountain’
item.description: In the heart of Montenegro on a Sinjajevina plateau, shepherds Gara and Nada spend their lives in the highlands of their ancestral mountain, which they call “mother.” The 2026 Sundance Film Festival documentary “To Hold a Mountain” follows the mother-daughter duo in their summer seasons on the mountain while they defend their home from becoming a NATO military training ground.
